---
title: "Love — a poem"
description: "Like a flower in the middle of weeds"
date: 2023-01-25
categories: ["Poetry On Medium", "Love"]
---

Like a flower in the middle of weeds

you are the beauty in a world much too cruel

Like a sea that’s overflowing

your love has no end

Like a candle in the wind

your flame is eternally lite

in my heart

---

*Originally published on [Medium](https://medium.com/@zemog/love-a-poem-301e7064dc7f) on 2023-01-25.*
